caption: The drawing features three views of a shoe: a side view in color, and two top and bottom outlines in pencil. The colored side view shows a shoe with a black front and middle section, a brown heel or back section, and a small yellow buckle on a strap across the instep. The shoe has a low black sole and a slightly pointed toe. Above the colored image, there are two smaller pencil sketches: one shows the shoe from above and the other the shoe from below, both without color. The main colored shoe is positioned horizontally, while the two outlined sketches are arranged vertically, side by side, above it. The background is plain and off-white, and the name "Roberta Spicer" is inscribed in the bottom right corner.
title: Man's Shoes
